title: A Survey of Data Agents: Emerging Paradigm or Overstated Hype?
abstract: arXiv:2510.23587v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has spurred the emergence of data agents, autonomous systems designed to orchestrate Data + AI ecosystems for tackling complex data-related tasks. However, the term "data agent" currently suffers from terminological ambiguity and inconsistent adoption, conflating simple query responders with sophisticated autonomous architectures. This terminological ambiguity fosters mismatched user expectations, accountability challenges, and barriers to industry growth. Inspired by the SAE J3016 standard for driving automation, this survey introduces the first systematic hierarchical taxonomy for data agents, comprising six levels that delineate and trace progressive shifts in autonomy, from manual operations (L0) to a vision of generative, fully autonomous data agents (L5), thereby clarifying capability boundaries and responsibility allocation. translated_title: 数据智能体综述：新兴范式还是被夸大的炒作？
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展催生了数据智能体（data agents）的兴起——这是一类旨在编排“数据+AI”生态系统以处理复杂数据相关任务的自主系统。然而，“数据智能体”这一术语目前存在术语模糊和使用不一致的问题，将简单的查询应答器与复杂的自主架构混为一谈。这种术语上的模糊性导致用户期望错位、责任归属困难以及行业发展受阻。受驾驶自动化领域SAE J3016标准的启发，本综述首次提出了数据智能体的系统性分层分类法，共包含六个级别，刻画并追踪了从人工操作（L0）到生成式完全自主数据智能体愿景（L5）的自主性渐进演进过程，从而厘清了能力边界与责任分配。基于这一视角，我们提供了一个结构化的重新（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本综述首次受SAE J3016驾驶自动化标准启发，提出了数据智能体的六级分层分类法，从L0人工操作到L5完全自主，以厘清数据智能体的能力边界与责任分配。
en_tdlr: Inspired by the SAE J3016 driving automation standard, this survey introduces the first systematic six-level hierarchical taxonomy for data agents, ranging from manual operations (L0) to fully autonomous generative agents (L5), to clarify capability boundaries and responsibility allocation.
